articles.title_en: Using satellites and phones to evaluate and promote agricultural technology adoption: Evidence from smallholder farms in India
articles.title_cn: 利用卫星和电话评估与推广农业技术采纳：来自印度小农场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates a low-cost, customized soil nutrient management advisory service in India. As a methodological contribution, we examine whether and in which settings satellite measurements may be effective at estimating both agricultural yields and treatment effects. The intervention improves self-reported fertilizer management practices, though not enough to measurably affect yields. Satellite measurements calibrated using OLS produce more precise point estimates than farmer-reported data, suggesting power gains. However, linear models, common in the literature, likely produce biased estimates. We propose an alternative procedure, using two-stage least squares. In settings without attrition, this approach obtains lower statistical power than self-reported yields; in settings with differential attrition, it may substantially increase power. We include a “cookbook” and code that should allow other researchers to use remote sensing for yield estimation and program evaluation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了印度一项低成本、定制化的土壤养分管理咨询服务。作为方法论贡献，我们考察了卫星测量在何种情况下以及哪些情境下能有效估计农业产量和处理效应。该干预改善了自我报告的肥料管理实践，但不足以显著影响产量。使用OLS校准的卫星测量比农民报告的数据产生更精确的点估计，表明统计功效有所提升。然而，文献中常见的线性模型可能产生有偏估计。我们提出了一种替代程序，使用两阶段最小二乘法。在没有流失的情况下，这种方法比自我报告的产量获得更低的统计功效；在存在差异流失的情况下，它可能大幅提高功效。我们附上了一份“食谱”和代码，应能帮助其他研究者使用遥感进行产量估计和项目评估。

articles.title_en: Therapy, mental health, and human capital accumulation among adolescent girls in Uganda
articles.title_cn: 乌干达少女的治疗、心理健康与人力资本积累
articles.abstract_en: Using a cluster-randomized controlled trial, this study evaluates the impact of group-based interpersonal therapy (IPT-G) on mental health and human capital accumulation among adolescent girls in Uganda who were at risk of moderate to severe depression at baseline. The study was designed to test whether lay provider-led IPT-G for adolescents could be effectively implemented using modest resources in a low-income country. It also tested whether a lump-sum cash transfer offered at the end of therapy provided any additional benefit. The therapy intervention alone increased the share of individuals with no depression by 5.4 percentage points (from 18.4% in the control group) 12 months after therapy, but these effects dissipated by the 30-month follow-up. Similarly, small positive effects on human capital accumulation at 12 months were not sustained at 30 months. Surprisingly, the marginal effect of offering cash transfers to IPT-G beneficiaries was large and negative on their mental health, persisting two years after baseline. The paper provides suggestive evidence that the adolescents were frustrated by their inability to use the cash towards their own goals because of the need to divert funds towards the essential needs of their families during the COVID-19 pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用一项群组随机对照试验，评估了团体人际治疗（IPT-G）对乌干达基线时存在中重度抑郁风险的少女心理健康和人力资本积累的影响。该研究旨在检验由非专业提供者主导的青少年IPT-G能否在低收入国家以适度资源有效实施，并同时检验治疗结束时提供的一次性现金转移是否带来额外益处。仅接受治疗干预在治疗后5.4个月时，将无抑郁症状个体比例提高了18.4%个百分点（对照组为12），但这些效应在30个月随访时消失。同样，在12个月时对人力资本积累的微小正面影响在30个月时未能持续。令人意外的是，向IPT-G受益者提供现金转移的边际效应对其心理健康产生显著负面影响，并在基线后持续两年。本文提供了提示性证据，表明在COVID-19疫情期间，由于需要将资金转用于家庭基本需求，青少年因无法将现金用于自身目标而感到沮丧。

articles.title_en: What one thinks, what one says and what one does: Male justifications and practices of gender-based violence in Mali
articles.title_cn: 所思、所言与所行：马里男性对基于性别的暴力的辩护与实践
articles.abstract_en: Gender-based violence (GBV) is widespread across the world. While the majority of the literature focuses on women as the victims of GBV, this paper studies men’s justifications for and perpetration of GBV in Mali, one of the countries with the highest GBV prevalence rates in the world. We elicit the prevalence of eight GBV-related opinions and behaviors among men in Bamako, the capital city, by administering a set of list experiments that we compare to a set of direct questions to estimate response biases. We find large support for GBV: nearly one respondent in two supports female genital mutilation or intimate partner violence. Besides, one in four has already physically hit an adult woman. Our results also show that several questions suffer from significant response biases when asked directly. Support for female genital mutilation is overreported, with actual approval being lower than openly stated. Conversely, justification of intimate partner violence is underreported, likely due to social pressure against it. While response bias varies little with respondent characteristics, prevalence rates are systematically lower among men with a secondary level of education. Our results are in line with response bias being shaped by the legal framework addressing GBV as well as prevailing social norms, highlighting the need for caution when using data collected through direct questioning.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于性别的暴力（GBV）在世界范围内普遍存在。虽然大多数文献关注女性作为GBV的受害者，本文研究了马里男性对GBV的辩护和实施情况，马里是世界上GBV发生率最高的国家之一。我们通过在首都巴马科对男性进行一系列列表实验，并与一系列直接问题进行比较以估计回答偏差，从而获取了八种与GBV相关的观点和行为在男性中的普遍性。我们发现对GBV的支持度很高：近二分之一的受访者支持女性割礼或亲密伴侣暴力。此外，四分之一的人曾实际殴打成年女性。我们的结果还表明，当直接询问时，若干问题存在显著的回答偏差。对女性割礼的支持被高估，实际认可度低于公开陈述。相反，对亲密伴侣暴力的辩护被低估，这可能是由于社会压力所致。虽然回答偏差随受访者特征变化不大，但拥有中等教育水平的男性的普遍性比率系统性较低。我们的结果与回答偏差受针对GBV的法律框架以及主流社会规范影响的观点一致，强调在使用直接提问收集的数据时需谨慎。

articles.title_en: Place-based Policies and Household Wealth in Africa
articles.title_cn: 地方性政策与非洲家庭财富
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides novel evidence on the impact of a prominent place-based policy – Special Economic Zones (SEZs) – on the economic well-being of African households. Exploiting time variation in SEZ establishment on a dataset of repeated cross-sections of households in 10 African countries during 1990-2020, we show that households living near SEZs become wealthier relative to the national average after SEZ establishment. The effect accrues mostly within 10 km of SEZs, is not driven by selective migration, and is accompanied by improved access to household utilities, higher consumption of durable goods, increased educational attainment and a shift away from agricultural activities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于一项显著的地方性政策——经济特区（SEZs）——对非洲家庭经济福祉影响的新证据。利用10-1990年间2020个非洲国家家庭重复横截面数据集中经济特区设立的时间变化，我们表明，经济特区设立后，居住在经济特区附近的家庭相对于全国平均水平变得更加富裕。这一效应主要发生在经济特区10公里范围内，并非由选择性迁移驱动，并且伴随着家庭公用设施获取的改善、耐用消费品消费的增加、教育程度的提高以及从农业活动的转移。

articles.title_en: Enforcing compliance with labor regulations and firm outcomes: Evidence from Brazil
articles.title_cn: 执行劳动法规与企业结果：来自巴西的证据
articles.abstract_en: In developing economies, many formal firms hire a portion of their workforce informally to bypass the costs of stringent labor regulations. While labor inspections serve as an important policy tool to ensure compliance, promoting a more competitive labor market, they may also have unintended consequences on firms’ outcomes. Using a unique set of administrative data that includes information on labor inspections, matched employer–employee data (RAIS), and credit registry data from the Central Bank of Brazil, this paper provides novel findings on post-inspection dynamics at the firm level within Brazil’s heavily regulated labor market. Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we observe a surge in formal employment without any immediate impact on revenue, suggesting that inspected firms tend to formalize their unregistered workers after an inspection. However, our results also reveal a large negative impact on firm performance and an increased likelihood of exit in the long run, indicating that audited firms struggle to offset the costs of formal labor. In addition, we find that inspected firms face tighter credit conditions, emphasizing the broader economic implications of enforcing labor regulations. By exploring heterogeneity across municipalities, we discern that the adverse effects of inspections are more pronounced in areas with lower informality rates. All in all, this research fills a gap in understanding how labor law enforcement affects firm dynamics, offering insights into the trade-offs faced by firms in heavily regulated environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 在发展中经济体，许多正规企业非正式地雇佣部分劳动力，以规避严格劳动法规的成本。虽然劳动监察作为确保合规、促进更具竞争力的劳动力市场的重要政策工具，但也可能对企业结果产生意外后果。利用一套独特的行政数据，包括劳动监察信息、匹配的雇主-雇员数据（RAIS）以及巴西中央银行的信贷登记数据，本文提供了巴西高度监管的劳动力市场中企业层面监察后动态的新发现。采用双重差分方法，我们观察到正规就业激增，而对收入没有即时影响，表明被监察的企业倾向于在监察后将其未注册工人正规化。然而，我们的结果也揭示了监察对企业绩效的显著负面影响以及长期退出可能性的增加，表明被审计企业难以抵消正规劳动力的成本。此外，我们发现被监察企业面临更严格的信贷条件，强调了执行劳动法规的更广泛经济影响。通过探索各市镇间的异质性，我们观察到监察的不利影响在非正规率较低的地区更为显著。总体而言，本研究填补了理解劳动法执行如何影响企业动态的空白，为高度监管环境中企业面临的权衡提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Peer learning and technology adoption in a digital farmer-to-farmer network
articles.title_cn: 同行学习与数字农民间网络中的技术采纳
articles.abstract_en: Information constraints rank high among barriers to agricultural technology adoption among small-scale farmers, particularly for complex bundles of complementary practices. Information communication technologies are emerging to extend the reach of agricultural training, with potential to deliver information through mobile and smartphones at little or no cost to farmers. In this study, we develop a low-cost digital extension platform that facilitates peer-to-peer learning through SMS-based chat groups on basic feature phones. Using a randomized controlled trial, we evaluate its effectiveness in promoting the adoption of beneficial agricultural practices compared to a one-way SMS extension program. We measure strong positive effects of treatment on adoption of practices discussed in the chat groups, increasing intercropping and organic fertilizer production by 11–18 and 15 percentage points, respectively, suggesting that a simple group discussion forum can be a powerful addition to digital extension initiatives. However, chat group participation declined over the course of the study, underscoring the challenges of designing technological interventions that sustain user engagement.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息约束是小农户农业技术采纳的主要障碍之一，尤其是对于复杂的互补实践组合。信息通信技术正在扩展农业培训的覆盖范围，有潜力通过移动电话和智能手机以零成本或低成本向农民传递信息。在本研究中，我们开发了一个低成本的数字推广平台，通过基于短信的聊天群组在基本功能手机上促进同伴学习。利用随机对照试验，我们评估了其与单向短信推广项目相比，在促进有益农业实践采纳方面的有效性。我们测量到处理对聊天群组中讨论的实践采纳有强烈的正向效应，分别将间作和有机肥料生产提高了11-18和15个百分点，表明一个简单的群组讨论论坛可以成为数字推广举措的有力补充。然而，聊天群组的参与度在研究过程中下降，这强调了设计能够维持用户参与的技术干预措施的挑战。

articles.title_en: The firm-pay gender gap and formal sector churn over the life cycle
articles.title_cn: 企业薪酬性别差距与生命周期中的正规部门流动
articles.abstract_en: We find that women sorting into lower paying firms explains nearly half of the gender pay gap in South Africa. Using matched employer-employee panel data covering the universe of formal workers, we show sorting varies considerably over the life cycle: the firm-pay gender gap is negligible for the youngest workers, grows steeply for 25–35 year olds (i.e. typical child-rearing years), and narrows for older workers. The increase is driven by those continuously employed — while women are almost as likely as men to switch firms, men are more likely to switch to better-paying firms, consistent with discrimination or non-pay amenities. Churn also contributes to the gap (though is relatively constant), since women enter formal employment at worse-paying firms than men. The relative importance of the continuously employed versus entrants depends on the size of the formal sector, thus linking the life cycle patterns underlying gender gaps with economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发现，女性进入薪酬较低的企业解释了南非性别薪酬差距的近一半。利用覆盖所有正规工人的匹配雇主-雇员面板数据，我们表明这种分类在生命周期中存在显著差异：最年轻工人的企业薪酬性别差距可忽略不计，在25-35岁（即典型的育儿年龄）急剧扩大，并在年长工人中缩小。这一增长由持续就业者驱动——尽管女性更换企业的可能性几乎与男性相同，但男性更可能跳槽到薪酬更高的企业，这与歧视或非薪酬福利一致。流动也对差距有所贡献（尽管相对稳定），因为女性进入正规就业时的企业薪酬低于男性。持续就业者与新人职者的相对重要性取决于正规部门的规模，从而将性别差距背后的生命周期模式与经济发展联系起来。

articles.title_en: Escaping from hardship, searching for comfort: Climate matching in refugees’ destination choices
articles.title_cn: 逃离困境，寻求舒适：难民目的地选择中的气候匹配
articles.abstract_en: Do refugees settle in destinations that are ecologically similar to their origins? We assess the relevance of “climate matching” theories of migration for Venezuelan refugees in South America. Leveraging social media data, we build the first local, bilateral matrix of Venezuelan flows across the region. Validation exercises show that this matrix aligns with independent data on Venezuelan refugees at the bilateral, destination and origin levels. We measure bilateral ecological similarities in terms of temperature, precipitation, elevation, and distance to the coastline. Performing Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood gravity models of migration, we show that Venezuelan flows are more likely between ecologically similar areas. Estimates are economically significant, and model predictions explain independent measurements of Venezuelans’ settlement choices at both bilateral and destination levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 难民是否会定居在与他们原籍地生态相似的地区？我们评估了“气候匹配”迁移理论对南美洲委内瑞拉难民的相关性。利用社交媒体数据，我们构建了该地区首个地方层面的委内瑞拉人流双边矩阵。验证练习表明，该矩阵与双边、目的地和原籍地层面的委内瑞拉难民独立数据一致。我们从温度、降水、海拔和距海岸线距离方面衡量双边生态相似性。通过执行泊松伪最大似然重力迁移模型，我们显示委内瑞拉人流更可能发生在生态相似地区之间。估计具有经济显著性，模型预测解释了对委内瑞拉人定居选择的独立测量，无论是在双边层面还是目的地层面。

articles.title_en: Labor market rigidity at home and multinational corporations’ flexible production reallocation abroad
articles.title_cn: 国内劳动力市场刚性与企业跨国灵活生产再配置
articles.abstract_en: An unprecedented regime change following the 2017 presidential impeachment led to a dramatic shift to more rigid labor market policies in the Republic of Korea, represented by consecutive double-digit hikes in the minimum wage in the next two years. Using a firm-level data set with detailed information about foreign affiliates over the period of 2013∼19, this paper assesses the employment consequences of stricter labor market regulations. The empirical evidence uncovers an underexplored mechanism through which domestic labor market rigidity can reduce domestic employment as multinational firms with flexible internal networks reallocate production tasks across borders.
articles.abstract_cn: 2017年总统弹劾后发生的前所未有的制度变革，导致韩国劳动力市场政策急剧转向更加刚性，表现为随后两年最低工资连续两位数的上调。利用2013年至19年期间包含外国子公司详细信息的公司层面数据集，本文评估了更严格的劳动力市场监管对就业的影响。实证证据揭示了一个未被充分探讨的机制，即国内劳动力市场刚性可以通过拥有灵活内部网络的跨国企业跨境重新配置生产任务，从而减少国内就业。

articles.title_en: When regional policies fail: An evaluation of Indonesia’s Integrated Economic Development Zones
articles.title_cn: 当区域政策失效：印度尼西亚综合经济开发区评估
articles.abstract_en: We study Indonesia’s Integrated Economic Development Zone (KAPET) program. Although firms in KAPET districts paid lower capital taxes, the program’s incentives neither stimulated entry nor increased output, and KAPET districts experienced similar development outcomes relative to non-treated districts. To investigate whether regional policies could be more optimally redesigned, we develop a quantitative spatial model where place-based capital tax cuts affect multiple sectors and impact a transfer system to finance local public goods. We find that capital incentives in KAPET areas would have been more welfare and growth enhancing if they had been accompanied by additional place-based improvements.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了印度尼西亚的综合经济开发区（KAPET）项目。尽管KAPET地区的企业支付较低的资本税，但该项目的激励措施既未刺激企业进入，也未增加产出，且KAPET地区相对于未受政策影响的地区，发展结果相似。为了探究区域政策能否更优地重新设计，我们构建了一个定量空间模型，其中基于地方的资本税削减影响多个部门，并影响为地方公共品融资的转移支付系统。我们发现，如果KAPET地区的资本激励措施辅以额外的地方性改进，其福利和增长效应将会更大。

articles.title_en: Lights, camera, school: Information provision though television during COVID-19 times
articles.title_cn: 灯光，摄像机，学校：COVID-19时期通过电视提供信息
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of phone calls designed to encourage viewership of the short telenovela Decidiendo para un Futuro Mejor (Deciding for a Better Future, hereafter DFM) on national television during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 in Peru. DFM uses video content to highlight the benefits of education while providing concrete information on wages and financial aid opportunities for higher education. We evaluate the impact of these calls on dropout rates in 2021 through a randomized controlled trial involving over 80,000 families with high school students. Our findings indicate that the phone calls led to a significant reduction in school dropout rates, with intention-to-treat (ITT) effects of approximately −0.6 percentage points—a meaningful impact given the 10.2% average dropout rate in the control group. The effects are stronger for students from schools with higher baseline dropout and poverty rates, with no significant differences based on parental education levels. Our results also suggest that the observed effects are primarily driven by encouragement to watch DFM rather than by the direct impact of the phone calls themselves. These findings underscore the potential of cost-effective interventions to mitigate the adverse effects of major economic shocks on educational trajectories.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在2020年秘鲁COVID-19大流行期间，旨在鼓励观看短篇电视剧《为更美好未来做决定》（Decidiendo para un Futuro Mejor，以下简称DFM）的电话对收视率的影响。DFM利用视频内容强调教育的好处，同时提供关于工资和高等教育财政援助机会的具体信息。我们通过一项涉及超过80,000个有高中学生家庭的随机对照试验，评估了这些电话对2021年辍学率的影响。我们的研究结果表明，电话干预显著降低了学校辍学率，意向性治疗（ITT）效应约为-0.6个百分点——考虑到对照组平均辍学率为10.2%，这是一个有意义的效应。对于基线辍学率和贫困率较高的学校的学生，效应更强，而父母教育水平没有显著差异。我们的结果还表明，观察到的效应主要是由鼓励观看DFM驱动的，而非电话本身的直接影响。这些发现强调了成本效益高的干预措施在缓解重大经济冲击对教育轨迹的不利影响方面的潜力。

articles.title_en: Migration and the epidemiological approach: Time and self-selection into foreign ancestries matter
articles.title_cn: 移民和流行病学方法：时间和自我选择外国血统很重要
articles.abstract_en: The epidemiological approach in comparative development uses data on individuals of immigrant origin to study cultural persistence, the determinants of cultural norms, and the effects of genetic traits. A common assumption of this methodology is its susceptibility to attenuation bias. We challenge it by demonstrating how the increasing reliance on foreign ancestries to identify respondents’ origins can introduce confounding biases. Specifically, self-selection in reporting foreign ancestry and unobserved variation in ancestral migration timing may lead to inflated estimates. We formalize these mechanisms through a theoretical framework and illustrate their empirical significance by reassessing key findings from influential studies by Fernández and Fogli (2006) and Giuliano and Nunn (2021).
articles.abstract_cn: 比较发展中的流行病学方法使用移民血统个体的数据来研究文化持久性、文化规范的决定因素以及遗传特征的影响。该方法的一个常见假设是其对衰减偏差的敏感性。我们通过证明越来越多地依赖外国血统来确定受访者的出身会如何引入令人困惑的偏见来对此提出挑战。具体来说，报告外国血统的自我选择和祖先迁徙时间的未观察到的变化可能会导致估计值过高。我们通过理论框架形式化这些机制，并通过重新评估 Fernández 和 Fogli (2006) 以及 Giuliano 和 Nunn (2021) 有影响力的研究的关键发现来说明其经验意义。

articles.title_en: The deeper roots of human capital formation and economic development in Southeast Asia, 1900–2000
articles.title_cn: 东南亚人力资本形成与经济发展的深层根源，1900-2000
articles.abstract_en: Since 1970, Southeast Asia’s per capita GDP grew seven-fold and headcount poverty rates declined from ca. 70 to 5%. This paper explores the 20th century schooling revolution as one of the deeper roots of this major leap in human prosperity. Using micro-data on the educational attainment and migration status of ca. 123 million individuals, subdivided across 277 provinces in eight Southeast Asian countries, we establish a strong and significant relationship between early educational attainment and sub-national economic development at the start of the 21st century. Using a wide range of historical and geographic controls, we find that higher education shares are more strongly associated with regional development outcomes than mass education. We also find a strong and robust contribution of inter-regional and international migration to human capital accumulation and long-term development.
articles.abstract_cn: 自1970年以来，东南亚的人均GDP增长了七倍，贫困人口比例从约70下降至5%%。本文探讨了20世纪的教育革命，将其视为这一人类繁荣重大飞跃的深层根源之一。利用涵盖八个东南亚国家123个省份、约277百万人的教育程度和迁移状况微观数据，我们确立了早期教育程度与21世纪初次国家层面经济发展之间的强且显著的关系。通过一系列历史和地理控制变量，我们发现高等教育占比与区域发展成果的关联强于大众教育。我们还发现，区域间和国际迁移对人力资本积累及长期发展具有强且稳健的贡献。

articles.title_en: Voter-buying, politician selection, and public good provision in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 巴西的选民购买、政治家选择和公共物品供给
articles.abstract_en: I study the consequences of voter-buying, defined as the act of inducing outsiders to fraudulently transfer their voter registration across jurisdictions in exchange for private benefits. Specifically, I explore the effects of Brazil’s 2007 voter re-registration reform which was intended to curb voter-buying. Exploiting a discontinuity in the targeting of municipalities assigned to the reform, I examine the response of mayoral elections, public expenditures and socioeconomic outcomes to the imposition of exogenous barriers to voter-buying. The reform led to an increase in political competition, and positive politician selection. Educated and qualified candidates who are less likely to belong to clientelist parties are more likely to enter and win mayoral elections. These political changes induce a rise in healthcare and school expenditures — programmatic public goods salient to poor voters. These increased expenditures result in better health outcomes, including reduced infant mortality, and better schooling inputs, including more schools, teachers, and student enrollment. Exploration of underlying mechanisms confirms that positive politician selection and changes to the electorate composition are the key drivers of the results. I also show that unintended disenfranchisement and incumbent reputation effects are not driving the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了选民购买的后果，选民购买的定义是诱导外部人以欺诈手段跨司法管辖区转移选民登记以换取私人利益的行为。具体来说，我探讨了巴西2007旨在遏制选民购买的选民重新登记改革的影响。利用分配给改革的城市目标的不连续性，我研究了市长选举、公共支出和社会经济结果对对选民购买施加外生障碍的反应。改革导致政治竞争的加剧和积极的政治家选拔。受过教育且合格的候选人不太可能属于庇护主义政党，更有可能进入并赢得市长选举。这些政治变化导致医疗保健和学校支出增加，而这些支出对贫困选民来说是重要的公共产品。这些增加的支出会带来更好的健康结果，包括降低婴儿死亡率，以及更好的教育投入，包括更多的学校、教师和学生入学率。对潜在机制的探索证实，积极的政治家选择和选民构成的变化是结果的关键驱动因素。我还表明，无意的剥夺公民权和现任声誉效应并没有推动结果。

articles.title_en: Making the most of coresident data: Credible evidence on intergenerational mobility with sibling correlation
articles.title_cn: 充分利用共存数据：具有兄弟姐妹相关性的代际流动性的可靠证据
articles.abstract_en: Many available data sets are not used for estimating intergenerational mobility owing to concerns about sample truncation bias in coresident data. Using data from Bangladesh, Chile, Ghana, India, Indonesia, and Mexico, we report the first evidence that the bias in estimated sibling correlation, a broad measure of relative mobility, is small in coresident samples (4.30%), much smaller than that in intergenerational regression coefficient (10.25%). The low bias reflects offsetting effects of sample truncation on the numerator and denominator of the sibling correlation formula. Sibling correlation estimates from coresident samples preserve the correct cross-country ranking 90%–95% times. Our findings have far-reaching implications for researchers working on intergenerational mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于担心共存数据中的样本截断偏差，许多可用数据集并未用于估计代际流动性。使用来自孟加拉国、智利、加纳、印度、印度尼西亚和墨西哥的数据，我们报告了第一个证据，表明估计兄弟姐妹相关性（相对流动性的广泛衡量标准）的偏差在同居样本中很小（4.30%），远小于代际回归系数（10.25%）。低偏差反映了样本截断对同级相关公式的分子和分母的抵消效应。来自共存样本的兄弟相关估计保留了正确的跨国排名 90%–95% 倍。我们的研究结果对研究代际流动性的研究人员具有深远的影响。

articles.title_en: Gender composition, social context, and academic performance in high-stakes examinations
articles.title_cn: 高风险考试中的性别构成、社会背景和学业表现
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how gender composition in high-stakes examination settings affects academic performance, using data from over 250,000 students in China's National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao). Leveraging random seating assignments, we show that female students significantly improve their scores and increase their chances of university admission when seated with more female peers, particularly those in immediate view. Male students show no significant response. These positive effects are stronger in regions with greater gender equality and weaker Confucian norms, highlighting the role of local social contexts. Our findings suggest that gender composition and social environment significantly influence academic outcomes in competitive settings, with implications for reducing gender disparities in education.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国高考（高考）超过 250,000 名学生的数据，探讨高风险考试环境中的性别构成如何影响学业成绩。利用随机座位分配，我们发现，当女学生与更多女性同龄人（尤其是那些眼前的女性同龄人）坐在一起时，她们的分数会显着提高，并增加她们被大学录取的机会。男学生没有表现出明显的反应。这些积极影响在性别平等程度较高、儒家规范较弱的地区更为明显，凸显了当地社会背景的作用。我们的研究结果表明，性别构成和社会环境显着影响竞争环境中的学业成绩，对减少教育中的性别差异具有影响。

articles.title_en: Relocation from China (with Chinese characteristics)
articles.title_cn: 从中国搬迁（具有中国特色）
articles.abstract_en: Rising global political tensions and increasing use of trade policies are popularly seen as potential threats to globalization. Will these factors lead to the ‘decoupling’ of affected economies, or reshape relations between trade partners in more complex ways? We consider this question by studying the recent evolution of the economic relationship between China and the US, in the context of a sharp fall in direct China-US trade. Using firm-level and product-level data, we show that Chinese manufacturing investment and Chinese-produced parts have increasingly flowed to third-country ‘winners’ who have simultaneously increased their US market share. This suggests that Chinese economic actors have continued to participate in reorganized China-US supply chains. We present evidence that our findings capture expanding indirect relationships linking China and the US rather than broader economic trends within the ‘winners’ themselves.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球政治紧张局势的加剧和贸易政策的日益使用被普遍视为全球化的潜在威胁。这些因素是否会导致受影响经济体“脱钩”，或者以更复杂的方式重塑贸易伙伴之间的关系？我们通过研究中美直接贸易大幅下滑背景下近期中美经济关系的演变来思考这个问题。利用企业层面和产品层面的数据，我们发现中国的制造业投资和中国生产的零部件越来越多地流向第三国“赢家”，而这些“赢家”同时也增加了美国市场份额。这表明中国经济主体继续参与重组的中美供应链。我们提供的证据表明，我们的研究结果捕捉到了中美之间不断扩大的间接关系，而不是“赢家”本身内部更广泛的经济趋势。

articles.title_en: Incentives and endorsement for technology adoption: Evidence from mobile banking in Ghana
articles.title_cn: 对技术采用的激励和认可：来自加纳移动银行的证据
articles.abstract_en: How can we encourage the adoption of digital financial services? We use an RCT with 115 microfinance groups in Ghana to understand the respective roles of individual incentives to adopt a technology and endorsement of the technology by a peer. We study mobile banking services, a technology which allows deposits and withdrawals between a mobile phone and bank account, dramatically lowering the transaction costs of saving in the bank account. We find that while individual incentives increase adoption of mobile banking services by 60% (6 percentage points) over 6 months, adding endorsement by a peer doubles the impact of the incentives alone. Peer endorsement significantly enhances confidence in dealing with fraud and increases peer support in using mobile banking. Those encouraged to adopt mobile banking by a peer save 30% ($4) more in the linked bank account 6 months later. Our study highlights the power of peers in encouraging technology adoption and facilitating formal financial inclusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们如何鼓励采用数字金融服务？我们使用加纳115小额信贷团体的随机对照试验来了解个人采用技术的激励措施以及同行对该技术的认可各自的作用。我们研究手机银行服务，这是一种允许手机和银行账户之间存款和取款的技术，大大降低了银行账户储蓄的交易成本。我们发现，虽然个人激励措施在 60% 个月内将移动银行服务的采用率提高了 6（6 个百分点），但增加同行的认可使激励措施的影响加倍。同行认可显着增强了处理欺诈的信心，并增加了同行对使用移动银行的支持。那些被同行鼓励采用移动银行的人在几个月后在关联的银行账户中节省了30%（$4）更多6。我们的研究强调了同行在鼓励技术采用和促进正式金融包容性方面的力量。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the labor supply implications of a cash transfer program: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 评估现金转移项目的劳动供给影响：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study evaluates the labor supply implications of China's Dibao program, one of the largest means-tested cash transfer initiatives globally. Leveraging its unique payment structure, which ensures a smooth income transition at the eligibility threshold, we employ a fuzzy regression discontinuity design to identify causal effects on employment outcomes. Despite the program's design to minimize disincentives, we find that Dibao beneficiaries are 46.2 % less likely to be employed after enrollment, with effects primarily driven by vulnerable groups, including the elderly and individuals with low educational attainment. Further analysis reveals significant labor supply reductions among low-income-contributing household members, while higher-income members remain unaffected. Our findings contribute to the discourse on cash transfers by highlighting how program design can balance social protection with labor market efficiency, offering insights for policymakers seeking to mitigate work disincentives while ensuring support for vulnerable populations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了中国最低生活保障制度（Dibao）的劳动供给影响，该制度是全球规模最大的经济状况调查式现金转移项目之一。利用其独特的支付结构，即在资格门槛处确保收入平滑过渡，我们采用模糊断点回归设计来识别对就业结果的因果效应。尽管该项目的设计旨在最小化抑制因素，我们发现Dibao受益者在加入后就业可能性降低46.2%，这一效应主要由弱势群体驱动，包括老年人和教育程度较低的个体。进一步分析显示，低收入贡献家庭成员中的劳动供给显著减少，而高收入成员则不受影响。我们的发现为现金转移的讨论做出贡献，强调项目设计如何平衡社会保护与劳动力市场效率，为寻求减少工作抑制同时确保对弱势群体支持的政策制定者提供见解。

articles.title_en: Quality signaling and demand for renewable energy technology: Evidence from a randomized field experiment
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源技术的质量信号和需求：随机现场实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Solar technologies have been associated with private and social returns, but their technological potential often remains unachieved because of persistently low demand for high-quality products. In a randomized field experiment in Senegal, we assess the potential of three types of quality signaling to increase demand for high-quality solar lamps. We find no effect on demand when consumers are offered a money-back guarantee but increased demand with a third-party certification or warranty, consistent with the notion that consumers are uncertain about product durability rather than their utility. However, despite the higher willingness to pay, the prices they would pay are still well below market prices for the average household, suggesting that reducing information asymmetries alone is insufficient to encourage wider adoption. Surprisingly, we also find that the effective quality signals in our setting stimulate demand for low-quality products by creating product-class effects among those least familiar with the product.
articles.abstract_cn: 太阳能技术一直与私人和社会回报联系在一起，但由于对高质量产品的需求持续较低，其技术潜力往往仍未实现。在塞内加尔的一项随机现场实验中，我们评估了三种类型的质量信号在增加对高质量太阳能灯的需求方面的潜力。我们发现，当消费者获得退款保证时，需求不会受到影响，但第三方认证或保修的需求会增加，这与消费者不确定产品耐用性而不是其实用性的观念是一致的。然而，尽管支付意愿较高，但他们支付的价格仍远低于普通家庭的市场价格，这表明仅减少信息不对称不足以鼓励更广泛的采用。令人惊讶的是，我们还发现，我们环境中的有效质量信号通过在最不熟悉产品的人中产生产品级效应来刺激对低质量产品的需求。

articles.title_en: The impact of violence on the dynamics of migration: Evidence from the Mexican Revolution
articles.title_cn: 暴力对移民动态的影响：来自墨西哥革命的证据
articles.abstract_en: Forced displacement from conflict has risen sharply in recent decades, yet little is known about how violence impacts migration dynamics in the short run or over a longer horizon. Using novel high-frequency data during the Mexican Revolution (1910-1917), one of history’s deadliest conflicts, we find that localized violence caused a sharp but temporary 60 percent spike in migration to the US, lasting only seven months before reverting to pre-conflict levels. We do not find evidence of increased migration after the Revolution, suggesting that refugee networks did not spur significant chain migration, even during an era of relatively open borders.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，因冲突而被迫流离失所的人数急剧增加，但人们对暴力如何在短期或长期内影响移民动态知之甚少。使用历史上最致命的冲突之一墨西哥革命（1910-1917）期间的新颖高频数据，我们发现局部暴力导致美国移民数量急剧但暂时60%激增，只持续了七个月就恢复到冲突前的水平。我们没有发现革命后移民增加的证据，这表明即使在边界相对开放的时代，难民网络也没有刺激大量的链式移民。

articles.title_en: Enforcement spillovers under different networks: The case of quotas for persons with disabilities in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 不同网络下的执法溢出效应：巴西残疾人配额案例
articles.abstract_en: This study examines labor law enforcement spillovers in Brazil, focusing on disability quota enforcement for formal firms. New inspection procedures increased compliance through heightened inspections and fines, boosting disability hiring. The largest increase is observed among individuals with mobility impairments, followed by those with visual and cognitive impairments. Most new hires came from outside the formal labor market, while some were poached from other firms. Additionally, job tenure for persons with disabilities in large firms improved. We investigate spillover effects across various firm networks: neighborhood, ownership, and human resources specialists. Results show that spillovers can have up to 3.4 times the impact on disability employment compared to direct fines. These findings highlight the potential for targeted enforcement strategies to amplify policy effectiveness beyond directly affected firms, even in developing economies characterized by low compliance with employment laws.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了巴西劳动执法的溢出效应，重点关注正规公司的残疾人配额执行情况。新的检查程序通过加强检查和罚款提高了合规性，从而促进了残疾人的雇用。增幅最大的是有行动障碍的人，其次是有视觉和认知障碍的人。大多数新员工来自正规劳动力市场之外，还有一些是从其他公司挖来的。此外，大公司中残疾人的工作任期也有所改善。我们调查各种公司网络的溢出效应：邻居、所有权和人力资源专家。结果表明，与直接罚款相比，溢出效应对残疾人就业的影响可能高达 3.4 倍。这些发现突显了有针对性的执法策略的潜力，可以将政策有效性扩大到直接受影响的企业之外，即使是在就业法遵守率低的发展中经济体中也是如此。

articles.title_en: The agricultural and economic impacts of massive water diversion
articles.title_cn: 大规模调水对农业和经济的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine the agricultural and economic impacts of China’s South–North Water Diversion Project, a massive initiative that channels water from the resource-rich south to the drier north. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the project increases total grain output by 8.2% and raises agricultural productivity by 4.7% in water-receiving counties. It also mitigates the adverse effects of drought shocks, leading to modest increases in local incomes. Improved water availability induces adaptive responses, including greater land allocation to water-intensive crops and a higher incidence of multi-cropping. Additionally, we find no evidence of significant losses in water-supplying areas. Our back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests an internal rate of return of 6.4%, underscoring the project’s economic viability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了中国南水北调工程对农业和经济的影响，这是一项将水从资源丰富的南方输送到干燥的北方的大型举措。采用双重差分法，我们发现该项目使受水县粮食总产量增加8.2%，农业生产率提高4.7%。它还减轻了干旱冲击的不利影响，导致当地收入小幅增加。水资源供应的改善会引发适应性反应，包括将更多土地分配给水密集型作物和提高复种作物的发生率。此外，我们没有发现供水地区出现重大损失的证据。我们的粗略计算表明内部回报率为6.4%，强调了该项目的经济可行性。

articles.title_en: From heat to high-tech: How innovation responds to climate change
articles.title_cn: 从高温到高科技：创新如何应对气候变化
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how firms respond to climate change through technological innovation. We emphasize that firms facing climate change are not always those innovating. Instead, innovation occurs either to mitigate a firm’s own climate-related damages (internal demand) or to supply climate-related technologies to other firms (external demand). To reflect this, we measure patent-specific exposure to climate change rather than traditional firm-level exposure to local temperatures. Our findings show that in China, climate adaptation patents increased by 8.62%, and climate mitigation patents grew by 10.68% in response to climate change. We document that new technologies respond positively to climate change due to rising public awareness, shifting demand, and regulatory pressures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了企业如何通过技术创新应对气候变化。我们强调，面临气候变化的企业并不总是那些创新的企业。相反，创新要么是为了减轻企业自身与气候相关的损害（内部需求），要么是为了向其他企业提供与气候相关的技术（外部需求）。为了反映这一点，我们衡量了特定专利对气候变化的暴露程度，而不是传统的公司层面对当地温度的暴露程度。我们的研究结果显示，在中国，为应对气候变化，气候适应专利增长了8.62%，气候减缓专利增长了10.68%。我们记录了由于公众意识的提高、需求的变化和监管压力，新技术对气候变化做出了积极的反应。

articles.title_en: Housing costs and real income differences across Chinese cities
articles.title_cn: 中国城市的住房成本和实际收入差异
articles.abstract_en: We document variations in real income for high-skilled, low-skilled, and rural migrant households across Chinese cities. Using comprehensive data on land parcel transactions along with individual data for land development and household expenditure, we construct a city-specific housing cost index and assess how it varies across locations. All three components of housing costs – unit land prices, land share in construction, and housing share in expenditure – decrease from city centres to the periphery, increase with city population, and decrease with city land area, as predicted by theory. Overall, housing costs in China are high and vary widely between locations. While income gains outweigh housing costs when moving from smaller to larger cities, in the largest cities, housing costs begin to dominate, particularly for low-skilled and rural migrant households. This suggests a bell-shaped relationship between real income and city population in China, aligning with theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了中国城市中高技能、低技能和农民工家庭实际收入的差异。利用地块交易的综合数据以及土地开发和家庭支出的个人数据，我们构建了特定城市的住房成本指数，并评估其在不同地点的差异。正如理论所预测的那样，住房成本的所有三个组成部分——单位土地价格、建设用地份额和住房支出份额——从城市中心到外围逐渐减少，随着城市人口的增加而增加，随着城市土地面积的增加而减少。总体而言，中国的住房成本很高，而且各地差异很大。虽然从较小城市迁移到大城市时，收入增长超过了住房成本，但在大城市，住房成本开始占据主导地位，特别是对于低技能和农民工家庭而言。这表明中国实际收入与城市人口之间存在钟形关系，与理论预测相符。

articles.title_en: Mitigating the health impact of a famine: Evidence from the 1985 Ethiopian emergency food aid
articles.title_cn: 减轻饥荒对健康的影响：来自1985埃塞俄比亚紧急粮食援助的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine the long-term mitigating impact of emergency food aid on health status using the food aid response to the Ethiopian famine in 1984 as a case study. Employing novel geospatial data on the location of relief camps where emergency food was distributed, we estimate the effect of proximity to a camp on height in adulthood. We compare different birth timings (born before or during versus after the relief operation) and different villages of birth (born close to versus far from a camp), exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in accessibility to emergency aid. Access to relief operation in early childhood leads to higher stature in adulthood. Aid beneficiaries also display higher later-life labor productivity in the agricultural sector, which suggests that the long-term health consequence of emergency aid may have translated into gains in agricultural productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们以1984中对埃塞俄比亚饥荒的粮食援助反应作为案例研究，研究了紧急粮食援助对健康状况的长期缓解影响。利用有关分发紧急食品的救援营地位置的新地理空间数据，我们估计了靠近营地对成年身高的影响。我们比较了不同的出生时间（在救援行动之前或期间与之后出生）和不同的出生村庄（靠近营地与远离营地的出生），利用紧急援助可及性的合理外生变化。在幼儿期接受救济行动会导致成年后身材更高。援助受益人在农业部门的晚年劳动生产率也较高，这表明紧急援助的长期健康后果可能已转化为农业生产率的提高。

articles.title_en: How good are livestock statistics in Africa? Can nudging and direct counting improve the quality of livestock asset data?
articles.title_cn: 非洲的牲畜统计数据有多好？助推和直接计数能否提高牲畜资产数据的质量？
articles.abstract_en: Livestock statistics in most low- and middle-income countries rely on self-reported, survey-based measures. However, respondents may have various challenges to accurately report livestock ownership. This study introduces a novel set of survey and measurement experiments to improve livestock statistics in Africa. We introduce two innovations to conventional livestock data collection methods. First, we address some of the sources of potential underreporting in livestock assets by introducing an explicit nudge to a random subset of survey respondents. Second, we arrange for direct counting of livestock assets by enumerators and local livestock experts. We demonstrate that self-reported data on livestock ownership suffer from significant and systematic underreporting. While our nudge affects only the reporting behaviour of households with larger stocks of livestock, direct counting increases total livestock ownership by 39 percent and the reported number of cattle by 43 percent. These impacts are evident at both the extensive and intensive margins of livestock asset ownership, as well as considering the number and value of livestock assets owned. Such mismeasurement in self-reported livestock data can lead to underestimation of the contribution of the livestock sector to national economies. Furthermore, direct counting generates important spillover effects to livestock species not explicitly counted in the survey. We finally show that underreporting in self-reported livestock data is systematic and hence consequential for statistical inferences. Our findings underscore that survey designs that can address specific sources of bias in self-reported livestock data can meaningfully improve livestock asset measurement in Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 大多数低收入和中等收入国家的畜牧业统计数据依赖于自我报告、基于调查的措施。然而，受访者在准确报告牲畜所有权方面可能面临各种挑战。本研究引入了一套新颖的调查和测量实验，以改善非洲的牲畜统计。我们对传统的牲畜数据收集方法引入了两项创新。首先，我们通过向调查受访者的随机子集引入明确的推动来解决牲畜资产潜在漏报的一些根源。二是安排普查员和当地畜牧专家直接清点畜牧资产。我们证明，自我报告的牲畜所有权数据存在严重且系统性的漏报问题。虽然我们的推动仅影响拥有大量牲畜的家庭的报告行为，但直接计数使牲畜总拥有量增加了 39%，报告的牛数量增加了 43%。这些影响在牲畜资产所有权的粗放边际和集约边际以及所拥有的牲畜资产的数量和价值方面都很明显。自我报告的牲畜数据的这种错误计量可能导致低估畜牧业对国民经济的贡献。此外，直接计数会对调查中未明确计数的牲畜物种产生重要的溢出效应。我们最终表明，自我报告的牲畜数据中的漏报是系统性的，因此对统计推断具有重要意义。我们的研究结果强调，能够解决自我报告的牲畜数据中特定偏差来源的调查设计可以有意义地改善非洲的牲畜资产衡量。

articles.title_en: The long-term effect of television on children's human capital development in China
articles.title_cn: 电视对中国儿童人力资本发展的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the long-term impacts of childhood exposure to educational television on human capital formation. We focus on CCTV-14, China's first nationally broadcast channel specifically designed for children. Exploiting variation in the timing of cable and satellite television rollout across communities, we document that access to CCTV-14 led to significant and persistent improvements in non-cognitive skills. These gains are particularly pronounced among left-behind children, suggesting that the channel played a compensatory role in addressing early developmental disadvantages. In contrast, we find no evidence of sustained effects on cognitive outcomes. The observed asymmetry underscores the importance of program content in shaping skill development. Finally, children exposed to CCTV-14 are more likely to achieve a higher socioeconomic status, better health, and enhanced digital literacy than those who did not.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了儿童时期接触教育电视对人力资本形成的长期影响。我们重点关注CCTV-14，这是中国第一个专门为儿童设计的全国广播频道。利用各社区有线和卫星电视推出时间的差异，我们记录了观看 CCTV-14 导致非认知技能的显着且持续的改善。这些成果在留守儿童中尤为明显，表明该渠道在解决早期发育劣势方面发挥了补偿作用。相比之下，我们没有发现任何证据表明对认知结果有持续影响。观察到的不对称性强调了计划内容在塑造技能发展方面的重要性。最后，接触过 CCTV-14 的儿童比没有接触过的儿童更有可能获得更高的社会经济地位、更好的健康状况和更高的数字素养。

articles.title_en: High temperature, power rationing, and firm performance
articles.title_cn: 高温、限电、业绩坚挺
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a theoretical framework and provides causal evidence explaining the rationality of government-imposed power rationing strategies during high-temperature periods in electricity systems lacking market mechanisms and price signals. By combining comprehensive panel data on Chinese firms with high-resolution meteorological data, we document robust evidence that high temperatures significantly reduce both electricity usage and operational performance among firms. We then construct supply shocks based on precipitation anomalies weighted by the inter-provincial hydropower dependence to identify power rationing. These analyses demonstrate the persistent prevalence of firm-level power rationing across China in recent years. Furthermore, we show that while redirecting electricity from industrial to residential sectors during heat-induced shortages reduces firm performance, this represents a welfare-maximizing outcome from a social planner's perspective. Our findings reveal how climate change intensifies inter-sectoral electricity competition, with market inefficiencies playing a critical role in explaining China's rationing patterns.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个理论框架，并提供了因果证据，解释了在缺乏市场机制和价格信号的电力系统中，政府在高温时期实施限电策略的合理性。通过将中国企业的综合面板数据与高分辨率气象数据相结合，我们记录了强有力的证据，表明高温显着降低了企业的用电量和运营绩效。然后，我们根据降水异常构建供应冲击，并通过省际水电依赖性加权来确定限电。这些分析表明，近年来，企业级限电现象在中国持续盛行。此外，我们表明，虽然在热引起的短缺期间将电力从工业部门转向住宅部门会降低公司绩效，但从社会规划者的角度来看，这代表了福利最大化的结果。我们的研究结果揭示了气候变化如何加剧部门间电力竞争，而市场效率低下在解释中国的配给模式方面发挥着关键作用。

articles.title_en: Trust and development in conflict-affected countries: Introduction to a special feature
Weather shocks, infant mortality, and adaptation: Experimental evidence from Uganda
articles.title_cn: 天气冲击、婴儿死亡率与适应：来自乌干达的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Climate change is increasing the intensity of extreme weather events. Health is a primary channel through which climate change affects welfare. Yet, estimates of the mitigating effects of health system strengthening are largely missing. We combine data from a randomized trial inducing variation in healthcare access with naturally-occurring variation in growing-season precipitation to study the adaptive impact of community healthcare in a low-income country setting. The risk of infant death increases following low growing-season rainfall, but access to community healthcare reduces this risk by 46 %. Using our estimates coupled with projections from climatological models implies even larger potential adaptive effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化正在增加极端天气事件的强度。健康是气候变化影响福利的主要渠道。然而，关于卫生系统强化缓解效应的估计在很大程度上缺失。我们将一项随机试验中诱导的医疗服务可及性变化与生长季节降水量的自然变化相结合，研究低收入国家背景下社区医疗服务的适应性影响。在生长季节降雨量低的情况下，婴儿死亡风险增加，但社区医疗服务的可及性将这一风险降低了46%。利用我们的估计以及气候学模型的预测，意味着潜在的适应性效应甚至更大。

articles.title_en: Herder-related violence, labor allocation, and the gendered response of agricultural households
articles.title_cn: 牧民相关暴力、劳动力分配和农业家庭的性别反应
articles.abstract_en: Violent conflict between nomadic herders and settled agricultural communities in Nigeria occurs as both groups clash over the use of land and natural resources, in part, due to a changing climate. We generate theory and evidence to study the labor responses of individuals within agricultural households to herder-related violence and consider a “shadow of violence” mechanism, whereby previous exposure to a violent event alters labor responses to a recent event. Using panel data from 2010 through 2019, we highlight how exposure to violence can lead to differing responses in the planting or harvest seasons and among men or women. In the planting season, among both men and women living in households with no previous exposure to herder-related violence, we find that exposure (i.e., singular exposure) leads to a reduction in household enterprise work, but among households with previous exposure experience, exposure (i.e., repeated exposure) leads to an increase in household enterprise work. Meanwhile, repeated exposure to herder-related violence reduces agricultural work among men only. This leads total hours worked to decline in response to singular exposure and to increase in response to repeated exposure especially among women. In the harvest season, we find that singular exposure increases agricultural work among both men and women, but repeated exposure reduces agricultural work among men only.
articles.abstract_cn: 尼日利亚游牧民和定居农业社区之间发生暴力冲突，因为两个群体因土地和自然资源的使用而发生冲突，部分原因是气候变化。我们提出理论和证据来研究农业家庭中个人对牧民相关暴力的劳动力反应，并考虑“暴力阴影”机制，即先前经历的暴力事件改变了劳动力对最近事件的反应。使用2010至2019的面板数据，我们强调了接触暴力如何导致播种或收获季节以及男性或女性的不同反应。在种植季节，无论是生活在没有经历过牧民相关暴力的家庭中的男性还是女性，我们发现接触（即单次接触）会导致家庭企业工作量减少，但在有过接触经历的家庭中，接触（即重复接触）会导致家庭企业工作量增加。与此同时，反复遭受与牧民相关的暴力只会减少男性的农业工作。这导致总工作时间因单次暴露而减少，而因重复暴露而增加，尤其是女性。在收获季节，我们发现单次暴露会增加男性和女性的农业工作量，但重复暴露只会减少男性的农业工作量。
